hints.title: Deferred Fuel Consumption
hints.text: Drive as far as your current fuel allows, recording stations you pass without stopping immediately.

hints.title: Largest Gas Capacity Extraction
hints.text: Whenever remaining fuel cannot reach the next station, greedily replenish fuel from the largest passed station.

hints.title: Exhaustion Detection
hints.text: If fuel is depleted and no past stations remain unchosen, reaching the destination is impossible. Otherwise, count each top fuel pickup.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List
import heapq

class Solution:
    def minRefuelStops(self, target: int, startFuel: int, stations: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        max_heap = []
        stops = 0
        cur_fuel = startFuel
        prev_pos = 0
        stations.append([target, 0])

        for pos, fuel in stations:
            cur_fuel -= (pos - prev_pos)
            while max_heap and cur_fuel < 0:
                cur_fuel += -heapq.heappop(max_heap)
                stops += 1
            if cur_fuel < 0:
                return -1
            heapq.heappush(max_heap, -fuel)
            prev_pos = pos

        return stops
```

complexity.notes: Greedy fuel consumption with priority collection of passed stations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Knapsack-style DP over state (station, stops) takes O(N^2) time and space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Auxiliary priority collection requires O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deferred refuel choice: treat passed stations as fuel reserves to claim greedily when empty.
